ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - CrackMapExec Process Patterns
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process patterns found in logs when CrackMapExec is used

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*tasklist\\ \\/fi\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Imagename\\ eq\\ lsass\\\.exe.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k\\ .*")) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*do\\ rundll32\\\.exe\\ C\\:\\\\windows\\\\System32\\\\comsvcs\\\.dll\\,\\ MiniDump.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ full.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%\\%B.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*tasklist\\ \\/v\\ \\/fo\\ csv.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*findstr\\ \\/i\\ \\"lsass\\.*")))
